The procedures shall include sequential diagrams of the test, repair, and inspection process, as well as the performance spcifications to perform the procedures. A parts control system shall establish a record of performance for each purchased and internally manufactured part and shall be used to evaluate continued use of the source. The contractors control system shall be in compliance wil either Mil-I 45208A/Mil-Q-9858 or equivalent Quality Quality Assurance Standared.(ISO/AS:9000, 9001, 9002). RECEIVING INSPECTION OF PURCHASED MATERIAL: Purchased items shall be inspected upon receipt at the contractors facility to assure conformance with all requirements of the Technical Data Package (TDP). Evidence of such inspections shall be maintained for Government review at least twelve (12) months following acceptance of the end item. Inspection reports shall be maintained by the contractor. The inspection report shall, at a minimum, include a record of all dimensional data (coordinate/positional), material, finish, and process with appropriate pass/fail criteria, such ascertifications, and actual dimensional readings. FAILURE ANALYSIS AND CORRECTIVE ACTION:All failure analysis and corrective action reports/plans shall be submitted to the Government. NONCONFORMING MATERIAL:The contractor shall establish an effective system for controlling nonconforming material including procedures for identification, segregation, and disposition. CONTRACTOR INTERNAL REVIEW BOARD (IRB):IRB authority is delegated to the contractor for this contract only. A complete file of IRB actions shall be maintained for review by the Government for concurrance of classification. MATERIAL REVIEW BOARD (MRB):Formal MRB authority for disposition of "AS-IS"and for minor non-conformances is retained by the Government. The contractor shall submit the appropriate request for Variance via the DCMC to the NAVSUP Contracting Officer. Sampling in quality conformance does not authorize submission of known defective items, either indicated or actual, nor does it commit the procuring activity to acceptance of any defective items. A quantity of CLIN's may be randomly selected from each quaterly repair production completion for shipment to the CFA or other Government designated location to conduct this testing. RECORDS OF DATA COLLECTION: The contractor shall maintain a historical record file to contain copies of applicable data and documents for individual CLIN's and assemblies by CLIN serial number. The historical record file shall include,but not be limited to the following types of historical records: Receipt inspection documentation. Repair shop travelers or repair cards. Parts replacement records. Parts inspection data before and after repair as applicable. Acceptance test data. Title: Chemical Storage Building
PopStreetAddress: 4525 Camp Hale Rd Fort Drum, NY 13602
Description: The chemical storage building must meet several specifications for construction, safety, and utility. The required minimum dimensions are 42 feet in length, 8 feet in width, and 8 feet 3 inches in height. Access shall be provided by a 60-inch by 80-inch set of double doors, with at least one 36-inch active leaf, centered on one of the 42-foot walls and secured with a padlock-compatible handle. For spill containment, the building must include a sump with a minimum capacity of 1200 gallons.The structure must feature a robust fire-rated design, with walls tested by Intertek for a minimum 4-hour rating and a roof tested for a minimum 3-hour rating. Electrical specifications include a 12-space, 100-amp NEMA 3R main breaker panel (120V/240V), two Class 1, Division 2 explosion-proof LED light fixtures with a switch for the interior, and a dust/vapor-resistant exterior light with a photocell installed outside the hazard zone. Ventilation will be handled by an explosion-proof exhaust system rated for 335 CFM or higher, suitable for petroleum-based storage and compliant with all NFPA/UFC codes, complete with an indicator light and an emergency shut-off switch.For safety and functionality, the building shall be equipped with a grounding kit including an 8-foot ground rod, 10 feet of cable, and a clamp. The interior will be furnished with three-tier, 5-foot-long shelves that are 14 inches deep with a 2-inch lip. A non-perforated, skid-resistant steel ramp, measuring at least 52 inches wide by 72 inches long, must be included. Additionally, the unit shall come with three 10-pound ABC dry chemical fire extinguishers: two installed inside on either side of the door, and one mounted outside in a weatherproof cabinet. The completed chemical storage building is to be delivered to Building P-91, Railroad Street, Fort Drum, NY 13602.

The contractor is responsible for purchasing and delivery of all materials to the Bonnet Carre Spillway's project maintenance yard (16302 River Rd., Norco, LA). a. Furnish 24 foot long (spans) and 20 foot long (spans) of hot dipped galvanized welded bar grating walkway panels in the quantities indicated in the bidding schedule. The galvanized welded bar grating shall be serrated, non-banded with bar dimensions of 1-1/4" x 3/16" (19-W-4). Grating panel widths shall be 27-5/8 inches wide. b. Furnish 1,000 hot dipped galvanized "G-Type" grating clips with adequate depth to secure the 1-1/4" depth grating panels. Submit quotes via email to Leann Thornton; Leann.R.Thornton@usace.army.mil
